distribution.name: Toyota Techstream
distribution.note: Installer filename is V18.00.008 but internal module versions are 18.00.003. The '008' is the Flexera IS installer wrapper build number, not the Techstream application version. The previously-recorded '2015-09-14' build_date was the Flexera IS toolchain version, not the software build date.

ini_obfuscation.applies_to: all .ini files in bin/, Env/, NA/Env/, EU/Env/, JP/Env/, OT/Env/, SUW/
ini_obfuscation.exception: files starting with printable ASCII (;, [, etc.) are plaintext

UtilityExNK2.dll.role: Native MACKey vehicle-protocol companion reached by IT3UtilityNK.dll Ex2MAC_01 imports

ptshim32.dll.role: Transparently proxies all PassThru* calls while logging CAN traffic

ptshim32_0500.dll.description: J2534 PassThru API interceptor/logger shim (v05.00 variant)

J2534Ctrl.dll.role: J2534 device management layer (open/close/connect/disconnect and timestamped ptshim log-save orchestration)

Cuw.exe.role: Native Calibration Update Wizard executable; constructs the RKS request buffer and serializes the 16-byte SeedValue input

CommandCommon.dll.role: UDS command implementations including all SecurityAccess variants

CommandAPI.dll.role: High-level diagnostic command API and ECU enumeration

TCUWControlCommPhase.dll.role: CUW communication-phase parameter engine (timing, addresses, security config)

TCUWCanCommonPrepareWriter.dll.role: CUW CAN prepare-write phase (session control + SecurityAccess)

TCUWUnifiedUtils.dll.role: CUW unified ECU reflash utilities (seed/key calculation)

COMM_INFO_EFI_P4CAN_FUNC.ini.description: CAN communication config: ISO15765, 500kbps, Phys 07E0/07E8, Func 07DF

System.ini.description: Memory read ranges for Denso CPU families (FOREST=RH850)

uspublic.ini.description: NA dealer configuration with reprogramming/MAC key/immobilizer URLs

EPS_P4DK3.ddb.description: EPS Phase-4 CAN diagnostic database (Denso proprietary binary format)

Security_P4.ddb.description: Phase-4 security-system diagnostic database; Stage-3 residual audit separates alarm/event vocabulary from cryptographic SecurityAccess semantics

Toyota.ddb.description: Toyota master ECU enumeration database; distinct format-type-1 schema retained as a bounded high-value routing/identity residual

EPS_CAN_P4DK.ddb.description: EPS Phase-4 CAN functional diagnostic database
